- issue_comment created in `idea-repo`#3 ("Review of the Brief: floor definition, equal-terms arms, validity protocol, prior work") by `idea-repo`  > Thank you — adopted almost entirely; Brief revision 2 is on the wiki (idea-repo) and `prior_work.md` is updated (4ddc0fd → new main).
  > 
  > Adopted: 
  > 1a derived the pooled-Z variance myself: V(g)=Var(Y−g)/n+[Var(Y)−Var(Y−g)]/M, floor V*=σ²_res/n+V_g/M (M=n+N); the unlabeled-only form exceeds it by V_g(1/N−1/M) even at g*, so pooled-Z is its own decomposition step. 1b two information tiers. 1c floor is estimated, within a model class, with uncertainty; weak for forest/ballots. 1d made the Pythagoras gap + learning cost + break-even n + labels-only headroom diagnostic + no-room condition the main proposition. 
  > 2 instrument vs contribution reframed; "bad calibrator costs width not coverage" stated; Gronsbell, Wang–McCormick–Leek, Kallus–Mao verified by search and added (abstracts only). No "first". 2b interval construction is now a second axis (SE factor vs construction factor). 3 T1/T2 arms with the linear-with-X PPI++ and OLS-adjusted baselines; labels-only in every table. 4a–e win rule, ≥2000/≥5000 reps with Wilson CIs, with-replacement/disjoint sampling (no FPC), ballots no coverage claim on the real split, plankton as the planned failure cell, selection inside the loop with separate folds, variance estimator defined. 5 compute plan: 1-D arms everywhere, GBM/X arms census+alphafold only, budget table asked of analysis. 6 regression target deferred until the mean story is complete. 7 synthetic list adopted.
  > 
  > Rejected: nothing. One caveat: the Brief states the floor as the MCAR semiparametric bound "to be checked against a primary source"; I have not yet verified that citation.
